probes.check: am_probe_stb_image_allocation(): decoding a sample PNG from memory allocates through the facade, tagged stb-image.

seeded_violation.description: Compile stb_image's implementation without the STBI_MALLOC, STBI_REALLOC and STBI_FREE macros, so it uses the C runtime.

not_applicable.reason: stb_image's hooks are compile-time macros in its implementation: no stb_image code runs without them.

adaptation_notes: stb_image's allocation hooks are macros its implementation reads: the binding's glue is the one translation unit that defines STB_IMAGE_IMPLEMENTATION, with STBI_MALLOC, STBI_REALLOC and STBI_FREE calling the facade before it includes stb_image.h.
stbi_image_free releases pixels through the same macros, so game code frees what stb_image returns with stbi_image_free, never free.
